method: One edge two-distance chamfered (d1=1, d2=2): V = a^3 - (d1 d2 / 2) a = 1000 - 10; A = 6a^2 - d1 a - d2 a - d1 d2 + sqrt(d1^2 + d2^2) a (two strips and two end triangles off, chamfer face on); the removed prism's centroid is d1/3 in from the reference face and d2/3 in from the other, so on this min-y/min-z edge (the reference face is the min-z one) the body centroid is (a^3/2 - a d2/3)/V in y and (a^3/2 - a d1/3)/V in z; 7 faces, 15 edges
